latest_financial_results.reason: The official financial library returns an E-IR dynamic container without a displayed date/document/PDF. The issuer-hosted preloaded configuration script was read; no report content was obtained. No latest period, profit, CET1 ratio or RWA figure is asserted.

missing_inputs.reason: Only FY2027 annual company forecast is observed. Period-end forecast is not automatically the t=1 one-year-end cash flow from the valuation date; future DPS path, payment timing and consistent share basis are not established.
No adopted externally sourced forecast-period equity cost is provided; the bank is not asked to supply the investor model parameter.
No adopted stable-period equity cost is provided; it is not copied from the forecast-period cost.
No explicitly grounded n+1 DPS is supplied; neither FY2027 forecast nor payout floor is perpetually extrapolated.
No independently adopted permanent dividend growth assumption or stable-phase justification is supplied.
No current price or price timestamp is fetched or invented in this bounded study.

required_missing_inputs: Current period-matched ordinary-shareholder attributable NI, regulatory capital numerator and risk-weighted asset disclosures
Applicable current Japanese/international regulatory definitions, consolidated/solo scope and transitional measures
Management target capital and buffer definitions, distinct from minimum regulatory percentage
Explicit future NI and regulatory-capital reinvestment paths for the same periods and units
Reconciliation of profit retention, capital allocation, buybacks, issuance, dividends and any dilution
Supported treatment of future capital distributions and valuation terminal conditions; no FCFE terminal value is computed here
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not use FAQ 8% as a CET1 ratio, management target, or reinvestment forecast.
Do not use accounting cash-flow CAPEX or debt movements as regulatory capital reinvestment.
Do not equate the 40% payout floor with maximum distributable cash or constant future DPS.
Do not add announced or hypothetical buybacks to DPS without a compatible per-share model.

answer_branches.if: The published definitions and matching period capital allocation are identified
answer_branches.then: Read and reconcile the public source; delete the question if resolved. No cost of equity, growth, DPS or trade action is automatically changed.

answer_branches.if: The answer clarifies a scope difference but does not supply period-matched public forecasts
answer_branches.then: Correct the scope description only. Regulatory reinvestment and future DPS remain missing.

answer_branches.if: No answer, unclear answer, or material not identified
answer_branches.then: Keep valuation unconfigured; do not infer low capital quality or a sell action.
